events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music and influence continue to reign supreme. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation, on the anniversary of the shooting that led to his untimely death. His legacy in music remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Still electrifying audiences decades later. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, the man who redefined the electric guitar, on the anniversary of his passing.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring timeless tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Magic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs... pure magic. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting continue to rock. What's your top Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine's Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem for peace, 'Imagine', was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' by John Lennon is a message that resonates through the decades. Forty-one years since its release, what does it mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', premiering in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and music of John Lennon. His vision still inspires.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese turns 87 today! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'! The Beatles' most eclectic work. Which track from this double LP is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Queen's Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song with Freddie?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'. The Beatles truly broke new ground with this album. Which track stands out for you?
